name: Ironcut Gorge
description: A substantial iron-mining adventure built around the gorge. A safe loading yard leads into branching underground workings, larger excavations and routes between elevations. The lower gorge contains another meaningful part of the adventure.

location.hint: Survey the existing mine entrance and the gorge below it; choose the network and exits from the rendered terrain.

requirements: A connected mine network with meaningful branch destinations and a way back.
Appropriate hostile inhabitants deeper in the workings, with safe retreat from the entry.
Use the lower gorge as part of the playable experience.
constraints: Keep the starting town and nearby established roads relatively safe.
Respect existing character and prop scale.
The current world is frozen; this example authorizes no content changes.
